exposure: Gestational Weight Gain (GWG) categorized as insufficient, adequate, or excessive
cohort: The cohort consisted of 695 pregnant individuals diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and obesity who received treatment at a tertiary university hospital.
finding: Excessive gestational weight gain (GWG) was consistently associated with unfavorable maternal and neonatal risks, including increased odds of cesarean delivery and large-for-gestational-age newborns, while insufficient GWG was not linked to increased adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Excessive gestational weight gain was associated with an increased odds of cesarean delivery.
